label: purchased_in_horizon
population: customers with >=1 purchase in the 365 days before the cutoff

features.name: recency_days
features.definition: Days from last purchase to the cutoff.

features.name: tenure_days
features.definition: Days from first observed purchase to the cutoff (left-censored at Dec 2009).

features.name: frequency_total
features.definition: Purchase invoices before the cutoff.

features.name: frequency_365d
features.definition: Purchase invoices in the last 365 days.

features.name: frequency_90d
features.definition: Purchase invoices in the last 90 days.

features.name: gross_spend_total
features.definition: Sum of non-cancelled line value before the cutoff (GBP).

features.name: gross_spend_365d
features.definition: Gross spend in the last 365 days.

features.name: gross_spend_90d
features.definition: Gross spend in the last 90 days.

features.name: aov_365d
features.definition: Average order value over the last 365 days.

features.name: median_order_value
features.definition: Median order value, all history before cutoff.

features.name: avg_products_per_order
features.definition: Mean distinct products per order.

features.name: median_units_per_order
features.definition: Median total units per order.

features.name: median_line_quantity
features.definition: Median quantity per purchased line.

features.name: avg_unit_price_paid
features.definition: Gross spend / units bought.

features.name: price_index
features.definition: Spend / (units x each product's median price before cutoff). <1 = pays below typical.

features.name: distinct_products
features.definition: Distinct stock codes bought.

features.name: distinct_product_groups
features.definition: Distinct product groups (heuristic taxonomy).

features.name: product_group_entropy
features.definition: Shannon entropy of spend shares across product groups.

features.name: top_group_share
features.definition: Share of spend in the customer's largest product group.

features.name: christmas_share
features.definition: Share of spend on Christmas-themed products.

features.name: repeat_sku_share
features.definition: Share of purchased lines re-ordering a product bought on an earlier invoice.

features.name: cancel_rate
features.definition: Cancellation invoices / purchase invoices.

features.name: cancel_value_share
features.definition: Cancelled value / gross spend.

features.name: mean_gap_days
features.definition: Mean days between distinct order days.

features.name: median_gap_days
features.definition: Median days between distinct order days.

features.name: gap_cv
features.definition: Std / mean of gaps (NULL with < 3 order days).

features.name: overdue_ratio
features.definition: recency_days / median_gap_days.

features.name: spend_trend_90d_log_ratio
features.definition: ln((spend last 90d + 1) / (spend previous 90d + 1)).

features.name: order_trend_90d
features.definition: Orders last 90d minus orders in the previous 90d.

features.name: active_windows_12m
features.definition: Number of the last twelve 30-day windows with a purchase.

features.name: spend_slope_rel_12m
features.definition: Regression slope of 30-day spend over 12 windows / mean window spend.

features.name: q4_spend_share
features.definition: Share of order value placed in Oct-Dec.

features.name: morning_order_share
features.definition: Share of orders placed before 12:00.
